exact_consumption_desc: The input produces a fixed number of servings (e.g. 1 kg of espresso → 93 cups).
batch_yield_desc: One input batch produces a defined number of units (e.g. 5 L of syrup → 50 × 100 ml bottles).
range_yield_desc: The input produces between a minimum and a maximum, with a standard (e.g. 70 to 100 cups per kg, 85 typical).
portion_yield_desc: One production (cake, tray) is cut into identical portions (e.g. 1 cake → 12 slices).
percentage_yield_desc: The item loses mass during preparation; only the usable share counts (e.g. 1 kg of fruit at 70% → 0.70 kg of pulp).
